--- delete_assert_rows_modified_param.sql
DELETE Q AS q WHERE q.id = @id ASSERT_ROWS_MODIFIED @count

--- AST
&ast.Delete{
  TableName: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 7,
        NameEnd: 8,
        Name:    "Q",
      },
    },
  },
  As: &ast.AsAlias{
    As:    9,
    Alias: &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 12,
      NameEnd: 13,
      Name:    "q",
    },
  },
  Where: &ast.Where{
    Where: 14,
    Expr:  &ast.BinaryExpr{
      Op:   "=",
      Left: &ast.Path{
        Idents: []*ast.Ident{
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 20,
            NameEnd: 21,
            Name:    "q",
          },
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 22,
            NameEnd: 24,
            Name:    "id",
          },
        },
      },
      Right: &ast.Param{
        Atmark: 27,
        Name:   "id",
      },
    },
  },
  AssertRowsModified: &ast.AssertRowsModified{
    Assert:  31,
    NumRows: &ast.Param{
      Atmark: 52,
      Name:   "count",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
DELETE FROM Q AS q WHERE q.id = @id ASSERT_ROWS_MODIFIED @count
